t: A credit card sized eight-core Linux computer with an AI helper and Wi-Fi 6.
steps: Buy the board from Arace, the Radxa partner store, or a reseller such as AmeriDroid. Pick a memory size.
Get a 5 volt USB-C power supply, a microSD card, and an HDMI screen.
Attach the Wi-Fi antenna to its connector before you start.
Download a Debian or Ubuntu image for the ROCK 5C from the Radxa docs site.
Write the image to the microSD card with an image writing app.
Insert the card and connect power, the screen, a keyboard, and a mouse.
Follow the Radxa getting started guide to finish setup.
Try a short Python script in VS Code to read a sensor on the 40-pin header.
meta: Open Board. From $44.90. A few stores.
